verdict.rationale: Jan is a desktop app positioned as an "open-source ChatGPT replacement". It downloads and runs local LLMs from HuggingFace or imported GGUF files. Its docs describe in-chat UI elements, including inline tool-approval panels within the chat, and projects with assigned assistants for conversations. Community use also confirms it as a local chat app. Missing for 10: detailed first-party documentation of the chat interface's own features (threads, editing, regeneration, parameter controls), and hands-on independent reviews of the chat UX beyond a brief community mention.
